bio.text: Amy Elik is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 111th District, serving since January 2021, according to the Illinois General Assembly.
Elik's legislature biography describes Elik as a lifelong resident of Madison County and a certified public accountant and auditor.
It says Elik is a former Foster Township trustee and former St. Mary's Catholic School board member.
